SELECT DISTINCT fiscal_year, MIN(fiscal_year_start_date) as fy_start, MAX(fiscal_year_start_date) as fy_first_day
FROM dim_date
WHERE calendar_year IN (2025, 2026)
GROUP BY fiscal_year
ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC
LIMIT 5

SELECT 
  m.home_store_id,
  COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) as new_members,
  MIN(m.join_date) as earliest_join,
  MAX(m.join_date) as latest_join
FROM dim_member m
WHERE m.join_date >= '2025-04-28' AND m.join_date <= '2026-05-03'
GROUP BY m.home_store_id
ORDER BY new_members DESC

WITH store_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    m.home_store_id as store_id,
    s.store_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) as new_members
  FROM dim_member m
  LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON m.home_store_id = s.store_id AND s.is_current = true
  WHERE m.join_date >= '2025-04-28' AND m.join_date <= '2026-05-03'
  GROUP BY m.home_store_id, s.store_name
)
SELECT SUM(new_members) as total_new_members
FROM store_counts

SELECT member_id, COUNT(DISTINCT home_store_id) as store_count
FROM dim_member
WHERE join_date >= '2025-04-28' AND join_date <= '2026-05-03'
GROUP BY member_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT home_store_id) > 1
LIMIT 10

SELECT 
  COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) as members_with_multiple_versions
FROM (
  SELECT member_id, COUNT(*) as version_count
  FROM dim_member
  WHERE join_date >= '2025-04-28' AND join_date <= '2026-05-03'
  GROUP BY member_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
)

SELECT member_id, COUNT(DISTINCT join_date) as distinct_join_dates
FROM dim_member
WHERE join_date >= '2025-04-28' AND join_date <= '2026-05-03'
GROUP BY member_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT join_date) > 1
LIMIT 5

WITH member_first_version AS (
  SELECT 
    member_id,
    home_store_id,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from ASC) as version_num
  FROM dim_member
  WHERE join_date >= '2025-04-28' AND join_date <= '2026-05-03'
)
SELECT 
  m.home_store_id as store_id,
  s.store_name,
  COUNT(DISTINCT m.member_id) as new_members
FROM member_first_version m
LEFT JOIN dim_store s ON m.home_store_id = s.store_id AND s.is_current = true
WHERE m.version_num = 1
GROUP BY m.home_store_id, s.store_name
ORDER BY new_members DESC
